title: Methyl-2,4-dihydroxybenzoate induces transcriptomic reprogramming in Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. cubense and defense gene responses in Kadali banana.
authors: Ajesh, B R; Nakkeeran, S; Renukadevi, P; Krishna Nayana, R U; Ashraf, Suhail; Udhayakumar, R; Hamed, Khalid E
one_liner_zh: 该文研究抗菌化合物MDHB对香蕉枯萎病菌的转录组影响及植物防御基因响应，属于纯转录组测序与湿实验验证，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: The emergence of fungicide resistance and environmental concerns with conventional chemicals necessitate the identification of novel antifungal compounds. Methyl-2,4-dihydroxybenzoate (MDHB), a hydroxybenzoate derivative, exhibits potent antifungal activity against Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. cubense, the causative agent of Panama disease in bananas. To uncover its molecular mechanism of action, we performed comprehensive transcriptomic profiling of Foc treated with 100 ppm MDHB using RNA sequencing technology. The analysis revealed 173 differentially expressed genes (DEGs), comprising 121 upregulated and 52 downregulated genes (|log(2)FC| > 1, FDR <0.05). Gene Ontology analysis showed that MDHB exerts multifaceted antifungal activity through membrane destabilization (47 membrane-associated genes affected), suppression of energy metabolism via downregulation of ATP-binding proteins and proton-pumping ATPases, oxidative stress induction through impairment of superoxide dismutase (SOD2) and antioxidant systems. It also disrupted protein synthesis machinery including ribosomal proteins and elongation factors. MDHB further compromised cellular transport by downregulating ABC transporters (STE6) and major facilitator superfamily transporters (PTR2), and disrupted N-glycosylation via repression of SRD5A3 and RFT1 genes. Plant defense gene expression analysis revealed enhanced immune responses in banana, with significant upregulation of WRKY transcription factors (5.9-fold), LECTIN receptors (5.3-fold), and MAPK signaling components (5.5-fold). Glasshouse trials confirmed MDHB's efficacy, reducing disease severity from 100 % to 4.4 % and limiting disease incidence to 16 % compared to 100 % in pathogen-inoculated controls. This study provides the first transcriptomic insights into Foc's response to MDHB, revealing a multi-target mechanism disrupting key cellular functions while enhancing plant defense, establishing MDHB as a promising antifungal candidate for sustainable Fusarium wilt management.
abstract_zh: 杀菌剂抗药性的出现以及传统化学品带来的环境问题，使得识别新型抗真菌化合物成为必要。甲基-2,4-二羟基苯甲酸酯（MDHB），一种羟基苯甲酸酯衍生物，对香蕉巴拿马病的病原体尖孢镰刀菌古巴专化型（Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. cubense）表现出强效抗真菌活性。为揭示其分子作用机制，我们利用RNA测序技术对经100 ppm MDHB处理的Foc进行了全面的转录组分析。分析揭示了173个差异表达基因（DEGs），包括121个上调基因和52个下调基因（|log(2)FC| > 1，FDR <0.05）。基因本体论分析显示，MDHB通过膜去稳定化（影响47个膜相关基因）、通过下调ATP结合蛋白和质子泵ATP酶抑制能量代谢、通过损害超氧化物歧化酶（SOD2）和抗氧化系统诱导氧化应激，发挥多方面的抗真菌活性。它还通过影响核糖体蛋白和延伸因子破坏了蛋白质合成机制。MDHB进一步通过下调ABC转运蛋白（STE6）和主要促进子超家族转运蛋白（PTR2）损害细胞运输，并通过抑制SRD5A3和RFT1基因破坏N-糖基化。植物防御基因表达分析显示香蕉中免疫反应增强，WRKY转录因子（5.9倍）、LECTIN受体（5.3倍）和MAPK信号组分（5.5倍）显著上调。温室试验证实了MDHB的功效，将病害严重度从100%降至4.4%，并将病害发生率限制在16%，而病原体接种对照为100%。本研究首次提供了Foc对MDHB响应的转录组学见解，揭示了一种多靶点机制，在破坏关键细胞功能的同时增强植物防御，确立了MDHB作为可持续镰刀菌枯萎病管理的有前景的抗真菌候选物。
